note: Pulaski County MO (29169) parcels are served by the county's Assessor Data MapServer (services8.integritygis.com, Pulaski_Assessor_Data, with Parcel and Owner Name layers). That endpoint returns 'Token Required', so it is login-gated and cannot be queried publicly. The county's public Parcel Viewer (pulaskicounty.maps.arcgis.com) draws from services5.arcgis.com ParcelUpdate_2026, but that service is Pulaski County, Virginia (coordinates near -80.6, 37.2), not Missouri. The integritygis H5 viewer and Geocortex hosts were unreachable from this environment. The state FMDC statewide parcel layer returned 404 or state-owned parcels only. Commercial vendors (Regrid, Acres, Dynamo) are paid and do not count.
